versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-dts-doc-parse 0.0.1

- Added initial documentation and implementation for parsing local PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and image files to Markdown using Alibaba Cloud DTS-AI.
- Refined agent handling with an expanded host mapping table (added support for "Pi").
- Clarified instructions for output file naming, destination selection, and conflict handling.
- Replaced file skill-card.md with comprehensive multi-file documentation and updated references.
- Improved request identity and package manifest validation procedures.

- Initial beta release of alibabacloud-dts-doc-parse Skill.
- Parses local PDF, DOCX, PPTX, JPEG, JPG, and PNG files into Markdown using Alibaba Cloud DTS-AI.
- Requires explicit user request or confirmation before uploading and processing files in the cloud.
- Supports output file naming, recovery workflow, and agent-based cloud job tracking.
- Provides detailed workflow, authentication, and error handling instructions.
